# Goal

This Rmd generates WES mutation summary plots for the **10 ER+ pILC samples with Bionano/OGM data**.

Important note: this subgroup contains 10 ER+ Bionano/OGM samples, but WES is expected for only 8 of the 10 samples. Therefore, WES mutation plots are based on the WES-assessable samples present in the combined MAF.

```{r paths-and-samples}
# ============================================================
# Input combined MAF
# ============================================================

combined_maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

# ============================================================
# Output directory for grant subgroup
# ============================================================

grant_out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/WES_ERpos_Bionano_n10"
combined_dir  <- file.path(grant_out_dir, "Combined_MAF")
plot_dir      <- file.path(grant_out_dir, "plots")
table_dir     <- file.path(grant_out_dir, "tables")

dir.create(grant_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(combined_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 10 ER+ pILC samples with Bionano/OGM data
# ============================================================

grant_samples_10 <- c(
  "TP05-232",
  "TP05-726",
  "TP07-626",
  "TP08-2202",
  "TP11-1516",
  "TP11-1780",
  "TP12-880",
  "TP13-820",
  "TP14-385",
  "TP15-M509"
)

# Subgroup MAF file that will be created by this Rmd
grant_maf_file <- file.path(
  combined_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_n10_WES_available_samples.combined.maf"
)

combined_maf_file
grant_out_dir
```

# Read combined MAF and subset to 10 ER+ Bionano samples

```{r read-and-subset-maf}
# ============================================================
# Read existing combined MAF
# ============================================================

if (!file.exists(combined_maf_file)) {
  stop("Combined MAF file does not exist: ", combined_maf_file)
}

combined_maf <- fread(
  combined_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  quote = ""
)

cat("Combined MAF dimensions:\n")
print(dim(combined_maf))

if (!"Tumor_Sample_Barcode" %in% colnames(combined_maf)) {
  stop("Tumor_Sample_Barcode column is missing from the combined MAF.")
}

if (!"Hugo_Symbol" %in% colnames(combined_maf)) {
  stop("Hugo_Symbol column is missing from the combined MAF.")
}

# ============================================================
# Clean sample names
# Handles names like TP05-232_T, TP05-232_Tumor, or TP05-232-T
# ============================================================

combined_maf[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := trimws(as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode))]
combined_maf[, Sample_clean := Tumor_Sample_Barcode]
combined_maf[, Sample_clean := gsub("_T$", "", Sample_clean)]
combined_maf[, Sample_clean := gsub("_Tumor$", "", Sample_clean)]
combined_maf[, Sample_clean := gsub("-T$", "", Sample_clean)]

# ============================================================
# Subset to 10 grant samples
# ============================================================

combined_maf_grant <- combined_maf[Sample_clean %in% grant_samples_10]

# Use clean sample names for maftools plotting
combined_maf_grant[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := Sample_clean]

cat("\nNumber of rows in subgroup MAF:\n")
print(nrow(combined_maf_grant))

cat("\nNumber of WES-assessable samples present in subgroup MAF:\n")
print(length(unique(combined_maf_grant$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)))

cat("\nSamples present in subgroup MAF:\n")
print(sort(unique(combined_maf_grant$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)))

# ============================================================
# Sanity check: which of the 10 ER+ Bionano samples are present?
# ============================================================

wes_sample_check <- data.table(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  Present_in_WES_MAF = grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
)

cat("\n========== WES availability among 10 ER+ Bionano samples ==========" , "\n")
print(wes_sample_check)

cat("\nNumber of ER+ Bionano samples:", length(grant_samples_10), "\n")
cat("Number present in WES MAF:", sum(wes_sample_check$Present_in_WES_MAF), "\n")
cat("Number not present in WES MAF:", sum(!wes_sample_check$Present_in_WES_MAF), "\n")

# Save sample availability table
fwrite(
  wes_sample_check,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_n10_WES_sample_availability.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

if (nrow(combined_maf_grant) == 0) {
  stop("No MAF rows found for the 10 ER+ Bionano samples. Check sample names in Tumor_Sample_Barcode.")
}

# Save subgroup MAF
fwrite(
  combined_maf_grant,
  file = grant_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

grant_maf_file
```

# Read subgroup MAF using maftools

```{r read-maf-maftools}
# ============================================================
# Read subgroup MAF for maftools
# ============================================================

maf_nonsilent_grant <- read.maf(
  maf = grant_maf_file,
  useAll = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

maf_all_grant <- maf_nonsilent_grant

gene_summary_grant <- getGeneSummary(maf_nonsilent_grant)
sample_summary_grant <- getSampleSummary(maf_nonsilent_grant)

cat("\n========== Gene summary for ER+ Bionano WES subgroup ==========" , "\n")
print(head(gene_summary_grant, 30))

cat("\n========== Sample summary for ER+ Bionano WES subgroup ==========" , "\n")
print(sample_summary_grant)

# Save summary tables
fwrite(
  as.data.table(gene_summary_grant),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_gene_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

fwrite(
  as.data.table(sample_summary_grant),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_sample_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

# Mutation status for requested genes

```{r requested-gene-status}
# ============================================================
# Mutation status table for CDH1, PIK3CA, ERBB2, ERBB3
# This is useful for the grant text/table.
# ============================================================

requested_genes <- c("CDH1", "PIK3CA", "ERBB2", "ERBB3")

# Non-silent / protein-altering classes commonly used for MAF summaries
nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Start_Codon_Del",
  "Start_Codon_Ins",
  "Stop_Codon_Del",
  "Stop_Codon_Ins"
)

maf_req <- copy(combined_maf_grant)

if (!"Variant_Classification" %in% colnames(maf_req)) {
  stop("Variant_Classification column is missing from subgroup MAF.")
}

maf_req <- maf_req[
  Hugo_Symbol %in% requested_genes &
    Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes
]

# Add common annotation columns if missing, so downstream code does not fail
for (col in c("HGVSp_Short", "HGVSp", "Protein_Change")) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(maf_req)) {
    maf_req[, (col) := NA_character_]
  }
}

if (nrow(maf_req) > 0) {
  maf_req[, protein_label := fifelse(
    !is.na(HGVSp_Short) & HGVSp_Short != "",
    HGVSp_Short,
    fifelse(
      !is.na(HGVSp) & HGVSp != "",
      HGVSp,
      fifelse(
        !is.na(Protein_Change) & Protein_Change != "",
        Protein_Change,
        Variant_Classification
      )
    )
  )]

  maf_req[, variant_label := paste0(protein_label, " [", Variant_Classification, "]")]

  requested_variant_summary <- maf_req[
    , .(
      mutation_status = paste(unique(variant_label), collapse = "; "),
      n_mutations = .N
    ),
    by = .(Sample = Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Gene = Hugo_Symbol)
  ]
} else {
  requested_variant_summary <- data.table(
    Sample = character(),
    Gene = character(),
    mutation_status = character(),
    n_mutations = integer()
  )
}

# Complete sample-gene grid for 10 samples
sample_gene_grid <- CJ(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  Gene = requested_genes,
  unique = TRUE
)

requested_status_long <- merge(
  sample_gene_grid,
  requested_variant_summary,
  by = c("Sample", "Gene"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

requested_status_long <- merge(
  requested_status_long,
  wes_sample_check,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

requested_status_long[
  Present_in_WES_MAF == FALSE,
  mutation_status := "WES not available"
]

requested_status_long[
  Present_in_WES_MAF == TRUE & is.na(mutation_status),
  mutation_status := "No non-silent mutation detected in this MAF"
]

requested_status_long[is.na(n_mutations), n_mutations := 0]

# Gene-level counts among WES-available samples
requested_gene_counts <- requested_status_long[
  Present_in_WES_MAF == TRUE,
  .(
    mutated_samples = sum(n_mutations > 0),
    total_wes_available_samples = .N,
    mutation_frequency_percent = round(100 * sum(n_mutations > 0) / .N, 1)
  ),
  by = Gene
][order(-mutated_samples, Gene)]

cat("\n========== Requested gene mutation counts ==========" , "\n")
print(requested_gene_counts)

cat("\n========== Requested gene mutation status, long format ==========" , "\n")
print(requested_status_long)

# Save long table
fwrite(
  requested_status_long,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_status_long.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# Save gene counts
fwrite(
  requested_gene_counts,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_gene_counts.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# Save wide table
requested_status_wide <- dcast(
  requested_status_long,
  Sample + Present_in_WES_MAF ~ Gene,
  value.var = "mutation_status"
)

fwrite(
  requested_status_wide,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_status_wide.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

requested_status_wide
```

# Somatic interactions: top mutated genes

```{r somatic-interactions-top25, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# ============================================================
# Somatic interaction analysis: top 25 mutated genes
# Same style as original script, but guarded for small n.
# For this small subgroup, treat this as exploratory only.
# ============================================================

if (nrow(gene_summary_grant) >= 5) {

  interaction_table <- tryCatch(
    {
      somaticInteractions(
        maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
        top = 25,
        pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
        returnAll = TRUE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("[ERROR] somaticInteractions failed: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(interaction_table)) {
    interaction_table <- as.data.table(interaction_table)

    fwrite(
      interaction_table,
      file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_top25_all_pairs.tsv"),
      sep = "\t"
    )
  }

  pdf(
    file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_top25.pdf"),
    width = 12,
    height = 10
  )

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
      top = 25,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  dev.off()

  png(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_top25.png"),
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
      top = 25,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  dev.off()

  # Show in Rmd output
  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
      top = 25,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

} else {
  message("Fewer than 5 mutated genes; skipping top-25 somatic interaction analysis.")
}
```

# Breast cancer gene somatic interactions

```{r breast-gene-somatic-interactions, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# ============================================================
# Somatic interaction analysis restricted to breast cancer genes
# Same style as original script, but focused on subgroup.
# For this small subgroup, treat this as exploratory only.
# ============================================================

present_breast_genes <- breast_genes[breast_genes %in% gene_summary_grant$Hugo_Symbol]
missing_breast_genes <- setdiff(breast_genes, present_breast_genes)

breast_gene_summary <- data.table(
  Total_breast_cancer_genes_in_list = length(breast_genes),
  Breast_cancer_genes_mutated_in_subgroup = length(present_breast_genes),
  Possible_pairwise_tests = ifelse(
    length(present_breast_genes) >= 2,
    choose(length(present_breast_genes), 2),
    0
  )
)

print(breast_gene_summary)

fwrite(
  breast_gene_summary,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_breast_gene_somatic_interaction_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

if (length(present_breast_genes) >= 2) {

  breast_interaction_table <- tryCatch(
    {
      somaticInteractions(
        maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
        genes = present_breast_genes,
        pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
        returnAll = TRUE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("[ERROR] Breast cancer gene somaticInteractions failed: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(breast_interaction_table)) {

    breast_interaction_table <- as.data.table(breast_interaction_table)

    fwrite(
      breast_interaction_table,
      file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_all_pairs.tsv"),
      sep = "\t"
    )

    p_col <- intersect(
      c("pValue", "p.value", "pvalue", "P.value", "PValue"),
      colnames(breast_interaction_table)
    )

    if (length(p_col) > 0) {
      p_col <- p_col[1]
      breast_interaction_table[, FDR := p.adjust(get(p_col), method = "BH")]

      breast_sig_interactions <- breast_interaction_table[get(p_col) < 0.05]
      breast_fdr_sig_interactions <- breast_interaction_table[FDR < 0.05]

      fwrite(
        breast_sig_interactions,
        file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_significant_pairs_p005.tsv"),
        sep = "\t"
      )

      fwrite(
        breast_fdr_sig_interactions,
        file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_FDR005_pairs.tsv"),
        sep = "\t"
      )

      cat("\nNumber of nominally significant breast cancer gene pairs, p < 0.05:\n")
      print(nrow(breast_sig_interactions))

      cat("\nNumber of FDR-significant breast cancer gene pairs, FDR < 0.05:\n")
      print(nrow(breast_fdr_sig_interactions))
    }
  }

  pdf(
    file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_breast_genes.pdf"),
    width = 12,
    height = 10
  )

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
      genes = present_breast_genes,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  dev.off()

  png(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_somatic_interactions_breast_genes.png"),
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
      genes = present_breast_genes,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  dev.off()

  # Show in Rmd output
  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
      genes = present_breast_genes,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

} else {
  message("Fewer than 2 breast cancer genes are mutated in this subgroup; skipping breast-gene somatic interaction analysis.")
}
```

```{r tcga-icgc-somatic-interactions, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
if (file.exists(tcga_icgc_gene_file)) {

  tcga_icgc_genes <- fread(tcga_icgc_gene_file, header = FALSE)$V1
  tcga_icgc_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(tcga_icgc_genes)))
  tcga_icgc_genes <- tcga_icgc_genes[tcga_icgc_genes != "" & !is.na(tcga_icgc_genes)]

  gene_summary_dt <- as.data.table(gene_summary_grant)
  gene_summary_dt[, Hugo_upper := toupper(Hugo_Symbol)]

  tcga_icgc_genes_present <- unique(
    gene_summary_dt[Hugo_upper %in% tcga_icgc_genes, Hugo_Symbol]
  )

  cat("\nTotal TCGA/ICGC genes:", length(tcga_icgc_genes), "\n")
  cat("TCGA/ICGC genes mutated in subgroup:", length(tcga_icgc_genes_present), "\n")

  fwrite(
    data.table(Gene = tcga_icgc_genes_present),
    file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_TCGA_ICGC_genes_present.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  if (length(tcga_icgc_genes_present) >= 2) {

    tcga_icgc_interactions <- tryCatch(
      {
        tmp_pdf <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
        pdf(tmp_pdf)
        res <- somaticInteractions(
          maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
          genes = tcga_icgc_genes_present,
          pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
          returnAll = TRUE
        )
        dev.off()
        unlink(tmp_pdf)
        res
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message("[ERROR] TCGA/ICGC somaticInteractions failed: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(tcga_icgc_interactions)) {
      tcga_icgc_interactions <- as.data.table(tcga_icgc_interactions)

      p_col <- intersect(
        c("pValue", "p.value", "pvalue", "P.value", "PValue"),
        colnames(tcga_icgc_interactions)
      )

      if (length(p_col) > 0) {
        p_col <- p_col[1]
        tcga_icgc_interactions[, FDR := p.adjust(get(p_col), method = "BH")]

        sig_p005 <- tcga_icgc_interactions[get(p_col) < 0.05]
        sig_fdr005 <- tcga_icgc_interactions[FDR < 0.05]

        fwrite(
          tcga_icgc_interactions,
          file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_all_pairs_with_FDR.tsv"),
          sep = "\t"
        )

        fwrite(
          sig_p005,
          file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_significant_pairs_p005.tsv"),
          sep = "\t"
        )

        fwrite(
          sig_fdr005,
          file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_significant_pairs_FDR005.tsv"),
          sep = "\t"
        )

        cat("\nNominally significant TCGA/ICGC pairs, p < 0.05:", nrow(sig_p005), "\n")
        cat("FDR-significant TCGA/ICGC pairs, FDR < 0.05:", nrow(sig_fdr005), "\n")
      }
    }

    pdf(
      file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions.pdf"),
      width = 12,
      height = 10
    )

    try(
      somaticInteractions(
        maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
        genes = tcga_icgc_genes_present,
        pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    dev.off()

    png(
      file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions.png"),
      width = 12,
      height = 10,
      units = "in",
      res = 300
    )

    try(
      somaticInteractions(
        maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
        genes = tcga_icgc_genes_present,
        pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    dev.off()

  } else {
    message("Fewer than 2 TCGA/ICGC genes are mutated in this subgroup; skipping TCGA/ICGC somatic interaction plot.")
  }

} else {
  message("TCGA/ICGC gene file not found. Skipping optional TCGA/ICGC somatic interaction section: ", tcga_icgc_gene_file)
}
```

# Optional: Oncodrive positional clustering

```{r oncodrive-positional-clustering, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# ============================================================
# Optional driver gene analysis based on positional clustering
# Same as original idea, but adapted to subgroup.
# This may be underpowered for n=8 WES-assessable samples.
# ============================================================

oncodrive_dir <- file.path(grant_out_dir, "Oncodrive_Positional_Clustering")
dir.create(oncodrive_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Candidate amino-acid/protein-change columns commonly present in PCGR/vcf2maf/MAF files.
aa_candidates <- c(
  "Protein_Change",
  "HGVSp_Short",
  "HGVSp",
  "AAChange",
  "Amino_Acid_Change"
)

aa_col <- aa_candidates[aa_candidates %in% colnames(combined_maf_grant)][1]

if (!is.na(aa_col) && length(aa_col) > 0) {

  message("Using amino-acid change column for oncodrive: ", aa_col)

  # For small cohorts, minMut = 3 is exploratory.
  # If this returns too few/no results, use min_mut_oncodrive <- 2.
  min_mut_oncodrive <- 3

  ignore_genes_oncodrive <- c(
    "TTN", "MUC16", "MUC4", "MUC5B", "MUC6", "MUC17",
    "OBSCN", "RYR1", "RYR2", "RYR3", "DNAH5", "DNAH7", "DNAH9"
  )

  ignore_genes_oncodrive <- intersect(ignore_genes_oncodrive, gene_summary_grant$Hugo_Symbol)

  oncodrive_res <- tryCatch(
    {
      oncodrive(
        maf = maf_nonsilent_grant,
        AACol = aa_col,
        minMut = min_mut_oncodrive,
        pvalMethod = "zscore",
        ignoreGenes = ignore_genes_oncodrive
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("[ERROR] oncodrive failed: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(oncodrive_res) && nrow(oncodrive_res) > 0) {

    oncodrive_res_dt <- as.data.table(oncodrive_res)

    sort_cols <- intersect(c("fdr", "pval"), colnames(oncodrive_res_dt))
    if (length(sort_cols) > 0) {
      setorderv(oncodrive_res_dt, cols = sort_cols, order = rep(1, length(sort_cols)))
    }

    fwrite(
      oncodrive_res_dt,
      file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncodrive_positional_clustering_all_results.tsv"),
      sep = "\t",
      quote = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )

    write.csv(
      oncodrive_res_dt,
      file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncodrive_positional_clustering_all_results.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    if ("fdr" %in% colnames(oncodrive_res_dt)) {
      oncodrive_sig <- oncodrive_res_dt[fdr <= 0.10]
    } else if ("pval" %in% colnames(oncodrive_res_dt)) {
      oncodrive_sig <- oncodrive_res_dt[pval <= 0.05]
    } else {
      oncodrive_sig <- oncodrive_res_dt[0]
    }

    write.csv(
      oncodrive_sig,
      file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncodrive_positional_clustering_significant_candidates.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    print(head(oncodrive_res_dt, 20))
    message("Number of FDR <= 0.10 positional-clustering candidates: ", nrow(oncodrive_sig))

    pdf(
      file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncodrive_positional_clustering_FDR0.10.pdf"),
      width = 10,
      height = 8
    )

    try(
      plotOncodrive(
        res = oncodrive_res_dt,
        fdrCutOff = 0.10,
        useFraction = TRUE,
        labelSize = 0.7
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    dev.off()

    png(
      filename = file.path(plot_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncodrive_positional_clustering_FDR0.10.png"),
      width = 10,
      height = 8,
      units = "in",
      res = 300
    )

    try(
      plotOncodrive(
        res = oncodrive_res_dt,
        fdrCutOff = 0.10,
        useFraction = TRUE,
        labelSize = 0.7
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    dev.off()

    # Show in Rmd output
    try(
      plotOncodrive(
        res = oncodrive_res_dt,
        fdrCutOff = 0.10,
        useFraction = TRUE,
        labelSize = 0.7
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

  } else {
    message(
      "No oncodrive results returned. Possible reasons: too few recurrently mutated genes, ",
      "missing/poorly formatted protein-change values in ", aa_col, ", or minMut is too strict. ",
      "Try min_mut_oncodrive <- 2 for exploratory analysis."
    )
  }

} else {
  message(
    "No amino-acid change column found. Skipping oncodrive. Available columns are: ",
    paste(colnames(combined_maf_grant), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```
